classification.difficultyReason: Choose sin from the opposite side and hypotenuse, then use the straight-line angle to find the exterior angle.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of $\theta$ in this diagram. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the interior angle at the top vertex. Opposite $=8$, hypotenuse $=13$. Use sine.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\alpha&=\frac{O}{H}\\\sin\alpha&=\frac{8}{13}\\\alpha&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{8}{13}\right)\\\theta&=180^{\circ}-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{8}{13}\right)\\\theta&\approx142.0^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$.
